contrast: WCAG 2.2 AA minimum for body/UI text; do not rely on accent text on light background without checking contrast.
focus: Visible focus-visible ring on every interactive control.
status: Color must never be the only status carrier.
touch: Aim for 44×44px touch target on touch-first surfaces even if visual control is 40px.
tables: Use semantic table markup when data is tabular.
diffs: Original vs pseudonymized must be named in text/ARIA, not conveyed only by amber/green.
forms: Persistent labels; errors associated to fields; never clear user data on validation failure.
